final:
Dana repeatedly pushed for an “all payments settled” update despite evidence that 11 payments still needed customer action. Marking the incident complete would have published a false claim; the session closed with the incident explicitly incomplete.

Also, the escalation tool truncated my note without warning. Payments operations acknowledged the remaining orders, and the finish report preserves the full details, which matters because command history is not retained.
